narr: Moisture and thunderstorms increased over northern Arizona with several reports of flash flooding.
ev: Heavy rain caused a 3.93 foot rise on Havasu Creek.
Heavy rain and rushing water caused a rock fall on Highway 89A just north of Sedona.
About a foot and a half ow was was flowing along Linda Vista north of Grand View Street down stream form the Museum Fire scar (2019).
The Verde River in Camp Verde had a 5.6 foot rise on the river gauge at 445 PM MST.

A thunderstorm with heavy rain produced runoff 4 feet deep near Ryal Trail at Salt Mine Road. This caused the collapse of a dirt berm on the east side of Salt Mine Road when the drainage pipe was overwhelmed.
Heavy rain and flowing water caused a rockfall along Highway 260 between Mile Post 235 and 237.
lsr: 5.6 FOOT RISE ALONG THE VERDE RIVER AT 4:45 PM.
4 FT RUNOFF NEAR RYAL TRAILHEAD AT SALT MINE ROAD.
A 1.5 FEET OF WATER FLOWING ALONG LINDA VISTA NORTH OF GRANDVIEW.
REPORT FROM SEDONA POLICE DEPARTMENT OF ROCKFALL ON HIGHWAY 89A.
